sn22.89:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn22.89:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarikārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.89:1.3: atha kho therā bhikkhū sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitā āyasmantaṃ dāsakaṃ āmantesuṃ
sn22.89:1.4: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi
sn22.89:1.6: kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamo sānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn22.89:1.7: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca
sn22.89:1.9: kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti.
sn22.89:1.10: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.89:2.1: atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca

sn22.89:2.4: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi
sn22.89:2.6: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā. seyyathīdaṃ.
sn22.89:2.8: imesu āyasmā khemako pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatīti.

sn22.89:3.6: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā. seyyathīdaṃ.

sn22.89:4.10: no ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati

sn22.89:5.5: no ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati tenahāyasmā khemako arahaṃ khīṇāsavoti.
sn22.89:5.6: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā. seyyathīdaṃ.

sn22.89:5.9: apica me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigataṃ ayamahamasmīti ca na samanupassāmīti.

sn22.89:6.7: apica me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigataṃ ayamahamasmīti ca na samanupassāmīti.
sn22.89:7.1: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi
sn22.89:7.3: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kimetaṃ asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:7.4: rūpaṃ asmīti vadesi. aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:7.8: viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadesi …pe… aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:7.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kimetaṃ asmīti vadesīti.
sn22.89:8.1: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca
sn22.89:8.3: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kimetaṃ asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:8.4: rūpaṃ asmīti vadesi. aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:8.8: viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadesi. aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:8.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kimetaṃ asmīti vadesīti.
sn22.89:8.10: alaṃ āvuso dāsaka kiṃ imāya sandhāvanikāya
sn22.89:9.1: atha kho āyasmā khemako daṇḍamolambha yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi
sn22.89:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ therā bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
sn22.89:9.3: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kimetaṃ asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:9.4: rūpaṃ asmīti vadesi. aññatra rūpā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:9.8: viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadesi. aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadesi.
sn22.89:9.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka asmīti vadesi kametaṃ asmīti vadesīti.
sn22.89:9.10: na khvāhaṃ āvuso rūpaṃ asmīti vadāmi napi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadāmi
sn22.89:9.14: na viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadāmi napi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadāmi
sn22.89:9.15: apica me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigataṃ ayamahamasmīti na ca samanupassāmi.
sn22.89:10.1: seyyathāpi āvuso uppalassa vā padumassa vā puṇḍarīkassa vā gandho
sn22.89:10.2: yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya pattassa gandhoti vā vaṇṇassa gandhoti vā kiñjakkhassa gandhoti vā sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti.
sn22.89:10.5: pupphassa gandhoti kho āvuso sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti.
sn22.89:10.6: evameva khvāhaṃ āvuso na rūpaṃ asmīti vadāmi napi aññatra rūpā asmīti vadāmi
sn22.89:10.10: na viññāṇaṃ asmīti vadāmi napi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadāmi
sn22.89:10.11: apica me āvuso pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu asmīti adhigataṃ ayamahamasmīti na ca samanupassāmi.
sn22.89:11.1: kiñcāpi āvuso ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti atha khvassa hoti yeva pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmīti māno asmīti chando asmīti anusayo asamūhato.
sn22.89:11.2: so aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati
sn22.89:11.3: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo
sn22.89:11.7: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
sn22.89:11.8: tassimesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yopissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmīti māno asmīti chando asmīti anusayo asamūhato sopi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
sn22.89:12.1: seyyathāpi āvuso vatthaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ tamenaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anuppadajjuṃ
sn22.89:12.2: tamenaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā saṃmadditvā acche udake vikkhāleti
sn22.89:12.3: kiñcāpi taṃ hoti vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ atha khvassa hoti yo ca anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato
sn22.89:12.4: tamenaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti tamenaṃ sāmikā gandhaparibhāvite karaṇḍake nikkhipanti
sn22.89:12.5: yopissa hoti anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato sopi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
sn22.89:12.6: evameva kho āvuso kiñcāpi ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti atha khvassa hoti yeva pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmīti māno asmīti chando asmīti anusayo asamūhato
sn22.89:12.7: so aparena samayena pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati
sn22.89:12.8: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo
sn22.89:12.12: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
sn22.89:12.13: tassimesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yopissa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmīti māno asmīti chando asmīti anusayo asamūhato sopi samugghātaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.89:13.1: evaṃ vutte therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavocuṃ
sn22.89:13.2: na kho mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihesāpekkhā apucchimhā api cāyasmā khemako pahoti tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññapetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ
sn22.89:13.3: yadidaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññapitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatanti.
sn22.89:14.2: attamanā therā bhikkhū āyasmato khemakassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
sn22.89:14.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhīmattānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu āyasmato ca khemakassāti.
